meta.name: competitive-analysis-process
meta.description: Orchestrate a complete competitive analysis across six steps, from landscape to strategic direction. Use when you need the full picture, not a single scan or card.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从市场格局到战略方向，完成六步竞品分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化了解竞争环境并制定策略
copy.tagline_en: Complete a six-step competitive analysis from landscape to strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic competitive landscape and strategic direction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成竞争分析的六个步骤：从市场概览、产品对比、客户需求满足度、商业基线、感知定位到战略方向，最后生成战卡、对比矩阵、定位反击方案和威胁评估报告。
howto.when: 当你需要完整的竞争分析（而非单次扫描），或在新财年战略周期、已有零散研究需要整理时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次完整的竞争分析，决策是是否进入中小企业市场。
say.note: Claude 会先确认范围，然后推荐步骤顺序。

say.text: 只做步骤2、3、5，针对竞品A，输出战卡。
say.note: Claude 会跳过其他步骤，直接生成所需产出。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates a six-step competitive analysis: landscape overview, product comparison, customer-need fulfillment, business baseline, perception & positioning, and strategic direction. It produces battle cards, comparison matrices, positioning counter-moves, and threat assessments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a full competitive analysis (not a one-off scan), e.g., for a new strategy cycle or to organize scattered research.

say_en.text: Run a full competitive analysis; decision is whether to enter the SMB market.
say_en.note: Claude scopes the decision and recommends step order.

say_en.text: Run steps 2, 3, and 5 only for competitor A, output a battle card.
say_en.note: Claude skips other steps and delivers the requested artifact.
